title: Universal effective cotangent cycle on a K3 Hilbert square from ramified-quotient foliations and its explicit nef obstruction
difficulty_reason: H2: the universal pseudoeffective threshold gives no effective cycle detecting non-nefness on the Hilbert-square locus. The author constructs two rank2 foliation subbundles on the diagonal blowup and proves their tangent images stay injective along the ramification divisor by analyzing the common fiber tangent and the one-dimensional quotient kernel. Their projectivized quotient bundles are exchanged by the involution and descend to a single codimension2 cycle. The pullback relation, original Chern/exceptional intersection data and quotient geometry give its exact class, whose top restricted intersection yields the stated nef obstruction. This actual effective-cycle construction and descent is the nonroutine burden; the final author-left elementary lengthy expansion, low-degree root specialization and named Hilbert-scheme inputs do not independently inherit H3 or get separate counts.
